description: This file implements a thermal monitoring class (CThermalMonitor) that interacts with system power management and hardware interfaces via IARM bus calls. It provides methods to get and set core temperature thresholds, retrieve temperature readings, manage over-temperature grace intervals, and emit temperature threshold change events.

classes.name: CThermalMonitor
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for monitoring and managing core temperature and threshold settings via IARM bus calls. Provides interfaces to retrieve current temperature, thresholds, configure thresholds, manage overtemp grace intervals, and emit events upon threshold changes.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CThermalMonitor.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an event observer, currently no implementation.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an event observer, logs the removal.

methods.name: getCoreTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves the current core temperature via IARM call.

methods.name: getCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Gets temperature thresholds for high and critical levels from hardware.

methods.name: setCoreTempThresholds
methods.description: Sets temperature thresholds for high and critical levels.

methods.name: getOvertempGraceInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the current over-temperature grace interval.

methods.name: emitTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Emits an event indicating the temperature threshold state change.

methods.name: reportTemperatureThresholdChange
methods.description: Logs or reports a temperature threshold change; currently a placeholder.
